case_title: GANTENBEIN,DAVID VS WEST AND PRASZKER REALTORS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $435.00 FILED BY GANTENBEIN,DAVID AS TO DEFENDANT WEST AND PRASZKER REALTORS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-25-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GANTENBEIN,DAVID RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WEST AND PRASZKER REALTORS $320.00 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $335.00, AMOUNT ACTUALLY RETAIN BY DEFENDANT STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT WEST AND PRASZKER REALTORS
